memory_rules: Treat absence/presence as a dated social fact only when the source actually records it.
A server, voice chat or platform is a context and relationship structure, not automatically an archetype.
Keep ordinary creation—games, food, music, HTML, TTS, hardware—beside later symbolic meaning.
When an external source corrects a Chronicle date, update chronology but preserve the Chronicle as evidence of what the project remembered.
